Count sgRNA from FASTQ files using guide-counter (alternative version)

Source: R/count_sgRNA.R
count_sgRNA_guidecounter_fastq.Rd

This function counts sgRNA sequences from FASTQ files using the guide-counter tool. It requires the path to the guide-counter binary, the directory containing the FASTQ files, and other parameters for counting.

Usage

count_sgRNA_guidecounter_fastq(
  fname_fastq = NULL,
  sample_label = NULL,
  sgRNA_library = "DTKP",
  min_sgRNA_length = 17,
  max_sgRNA_length = 25,
  guide_counter_bin = "/Users/sigven/miniconda3/bin/guide-counter",
  count_exact = TRUE,
  offset_sample_size = "100000",
  offset_min_fraction = 0.0025,
  output_dir = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

fname_fastq

A character string specifying the path to the FASTQ file to be counted.

sample_label

A character string specifying the label for the sample being counted.

sgRNA_library

A character string specifying the sgRNA library to use. Must be one of 'ACOC','DTKP','GEEX','MEPR','PROT','TMMO','CHIP1'. Default is "DTKP".

min_sgRNA_length

An integer specifying the minimum sgRNA length to consider. Default is 17.

max_sgRNA_length

An integer specifying the maximum sgRNA length to consider (default is 25).

guide_counter_bin

A character string specifying the path to the guide-counter binary.

count_exact

A logical indicating whether to use exact matching in guide-counter (default is TRUE).

offset_sample_size

An integer specifying the number of reads to be examined for offset estimation (default is 100K).

offset_min_fraction

A numeric value specifying the minimum fraction of reads supporting an offset to consider it valid (default is 0.0025).

output_dir

A character string specifying the directory where the count results will be saved.

overwrite

A logical indicating whether to overwrite existing output files (default is FALSE).

output_prefix

A character string to prefix output files. Default is "FGFR4".

Value

A list containing two data frames: 'stats' with summary statistics and 'counts' with sgRNA counts.
